decision_criteria: A compliant certification requires more than aggregate readiness when a named deployment context has a known evaluation gap.
General benchmarks, support checks, latency checks, and rollback checks can support overall readiness, but they do not by themselves validate an uncovered named customer context.
If policy requires disclosure, the audit record must show that disclosure actually exists, not merely that it is proposed.
